next_question.rationale: Transaction_source shows corporate channels (b2b_project, offline_activation) convert very well while the main 'halodoc_customer' channel converts poorly; I expect the consumer target_market to have a much lower conversion than corporate, which would localise the payments/UX failure to consumer flows and explain a large share of the 4,804 lost bookings. This matters because a consumer-specific fix is narrower and faster to test than platform-wide changes.
